title: outline
body:
## outline

Produces the 12 edges of the input's axis-aligned bounding box as polydata lines. Use it as a context frame in scenes or to check a dataset's extent; it carries no field data.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The box is axis-aligned, so it can be much larger than a rotated or thin object.

Native constructor: `Outline`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); graphs (vertices and edges) (vtkGraph). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkGraph"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

No authored options.


Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "outline",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
